app.tagline: Your business insights in one place

catalogHealthCard.catalogHealthReflectsCurrentCatalogInteg: Catalog Health reflects current catalog/integration state; the selected reporting period does not filter it.
catalogHealthCard.diagnosticOnlyNoAutoFixRetail: Diagnostic only — no auto-fix. Retail inventory is authoritative; provider stock is downstream published state. Read-only: providers are never contacted live.
catalogHealthCard.truncated: Showing the first {count} rows; summary counts are complete.

categoryCard.productsCanBelongToMultipleSubcategories: Products can belong to multiple subcategories, so subcategories do not form parts of a single whole — bar view only.

devicesPage.onlineMeansCloudHeardFromThe: Online means Cloud heard from the Retail app recently (a sync upload or a control poll). It does not prove data is current; Last data shows when sync data last arrived.
devicesPage.syncingNotPolledYetSyncNow: Syncing, not polled yet — Sync Now waits for its first poll
devicesPage.syncingControlPollStaleSyncNow: Syncing, control poll stale — Sync Now may be delayed

latestSalesCard.orderTrackingArrivesWithOnlineCommerce: Order tracking arrives with online-commerce integration

loginPage.twoStepVerificationIsRequiredFor: Two-step verification is required for every account. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
loginPage.qrCodeForYourAuthenticatorApp: QR code for your authenticator app
loginPage.saveTheseOneTimeRecoveryCodes: Save these one-time recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They will not be shown again.
loginPage.activateHint: Activate your account — choose a password (at least 12 characters).

messagingSettings.invalidAddressWhatsappNeedsAnInternation: Invalid address: WhatsApp needs an international number (such as 201012345678); Telegram a numeric chat ID or @username.
messagingSettings.aScheduleWithThisNameAlready: A schedule with this name already exists.
messagingSettings.youDoNotHavePermissionTo: You do not have permission to change report delivery.
messagingSettings.theReportWillBeSentWithin: The report will be sent within about a minute.
messagingSettings.queuedButTheSchedulerIsOff: Queued, but the scheduler is off, so nothing is sent until it is enabled.
messagingSettings.sendingReportsOverWhatsappAndTelegram: Sending reports over WhatsApp and Telegram
messagingSettings.aDailyOr10DaySummary: A daily or 10-day summary for every Store, sent at the chosen Cairo time.
messagingSettings.theSchedulerIsOffOnThe: The scheduler is off on the server, so no report is sent. Turn it on with BUSINESS_REPORTS_ENABLED=true and restart Cloud.
messagingSettings.noMessagingProviderIsEnabledWhatsapp: No messaging provider is enabled. WhatsApp and Telegram credentials (secret tokens) are set in the server environment; see docs/operations/notifications-whatsapp.md and notifications-telegram.md.
messagingSettings.whatsappSendsAMetaApprovedTemplate: WhatsApp sends a Meta-approved template with one parameter carrying the report text. Telegram sends the text directly.
messagingSettings.name: Name

onlineComparison.onlineOrdersAreOperationalProviderOrders: Online orders are operational provider orders and may not represent additional recognized revenue beyond finalized Retail Sales. The two sources are shown separately and never summed.
onlineComparison.noOrderValue: No online order value in this period.

ordersPage.containsProductsNotMappedToMoonlight: Contains products not mapped to MoonLight catalog
ordersPage.deletedAtProviderLastKnownDetails: Deleted at provider — last-known details shown

periodSelector.startDateMustNotBeAfter: Start date must not be after end date

reportsPage.salesPerformanceFromTransactionsSyncedFr: Sales performance from transactions synced from MoonLightRetail
reportsPage.currentStockAndTheZakatCalculation: Current stock and the zakat calculation

salesCard.totalInEgpConvertsEachUsd: Total in EGP converts each USD sale and refund at the rate saved with it.
salesCard.netProfitNetSalesTaxCost: Net profit = net sales − tax − cost of goods. Items without a recorded cost add no cost.

salesReportView.thereIsNoUsdExchangeRate: There is no USD exchange rate yet. Add one on the Settings page.
salesReportView.chooseAStoreAtTheTop: Choose a Store at the top of the page.
salesReportView.youDoNotHavePermissionTo: You do not have permission to view reports.
salesReportView.theReportCouldNotBeLoaded: The report could not be loaded. Try again.
salesReportView.classificationAndPaymentFiltersSelectCom: Classification and payment filters select complete sales containing a matching historical item; complete sale totals and payments remain intact.
salesReportView.eachCurrencyIsShownSeparatelyWithout: Each currency is shown separately, without conversion.
salesReportView.thePeriodAndStoreComeFrom: The period and Store come from the top of the page.
salesReportView.optionalEgpCostsForThisReport: Optional EGP costs for this report and printout only. They are not saved.
salesReportView.everyCostNeedsAShortDescription: Every cost needs a short description and a positive amount with at most two decimals.
salesReportView.chooseAnotherPeriodOrClearThe: Choose another period or clear the report filters.
salesReportView.chooseAnotherPeriodOrStoreAt: Choose another period or Store at the top of the page.
salesReportView.salesTaxNetRevenueNetRevenue: Sales − tax = net revenue. Net revenue − original cost = gross profit. Extra costs are deducted afterward.
salesReportView.salesOriginalCostGrossProfitExtra: Sales − original cost = gross profit. Extra costs are deducted afterward.
salesReportView.usdAmountsUseTheExchangeRate: USD amounts use the exchange rate saved with each sale or refund.
salesReportView.usdRatesUsedInThisPeriod: USD rates used in this period
salesReportView.eachSaleConvertsAtTheUsd: Each sale converts at the USD rate saved on it, or the rate in effect on the day it was made. The rate changes from day to day, so past sales can use a different rate from the latest one.
salesReportView.onlyReturnedItemsPutBackInto: Only returned items put back into stock reverse cost. Refunds without restocking reduce revenue; their cost remains.
salesReportView.attributedTotalsMayOverlapBecauseOne: Attributed totals may overlap because one item can have several classifications. Amounts are item totals before sale discounts and tax.
salesReportView.tagGroupsOverlapOneSaleItem: Tag groups overlap: one sale item may carry several tags, so group totals can exceed the overall total.

settingsPage.someoneElseJustChangedTheseSettings: Someone else just changed these settings. They were reloaded; review and save again.
settingsPage.aRateAlreadyStartsAtThat: A rate already starts at that time. Choose another time.
settingsPage.youDoNotHavePermissionTo: You do not have permission to change settings.
settingsPage.settingsSavedReportsUseThemRight: Settings saved. Reports use them right away.
settingsPage.enterAPositiveRateWithAt: Enter a positive rate with at most six decimals, such as 50.25.
settingsPage.settingsForEveryStoreWhatReports: Settings for every Store: what reports show, exchange rates and sending reports.
settingsPage.viewOnlyAnOwnerOrAdmin: View only: an owner or admin with access to every Store changes these settings.
settingsPage.asInMoonlightretailAFeatureThat: As in MoonLightRetail: a feature that is off disappears from reports unless the period still holds such amounts.
settingsPage.whenOffSalesAndRefundsAre: When off, sales and refunds are shown without tax and the tax rows disappear.
settingsPage.showsTheTableExplainingSaleTotals: Shows the table explaining sale totals and their discounts.
settingsPage.showsTheReturnsAndRefundsColumns: Shows the returns and refunds columns and the reconciliation tables.
settingsPage.whenEgpSalesAreShownIn: When EGP sales are shown in USD, reports use the rate in effect when each sale was made. USD sales always keep the rate saved with them in MoonLightRetail.
settingsPage.noRatesYetWithoutOneEgp: No rates yet. Without one, EGP sales convert at the rate of the Store’s nearest USD sale.

stocktakingView.chooseAStoreAtTheTop: Choose a Store at the top of the page.
stocktakingView.youDoNotHavePermissionTo: You do not have permission to view reports.
stocktakingView.theStocktakingCouldNotBeLoaded: The stocktaking could not be loaded. Try again.
stocktakingView.stockOnHandAsLastSynced: Stock on hand as last synced from MoonLightRetail, valued at cost and at the current EGP selling price.
stocktakingView.eachSkuUsesItsOwnCost: Each SKU uses its own cost and price when set, otherwise the product cost and price. USD prices are not included.
stocktakingView.unitsOfInactiveProductsOrSkus: Units of inactive products or SKUs
stocktakingView.someStockHasNoCostOr: Some stock has no cost or EGP price, so its value is missing from the totals.
stocktakingView.zakatOnShopStockIsDue: Zakat on shop stock is due once a full year passes while the zakatable total stays at or above nisab. Enter today’s gold price and the shop’s other money to calculate it.
stocktakingView.leaveAFieldEmptyForZero: Leave a field empty for zero. These figures are neither saved nor sent.
stocktakingView.enterPositiveAmountsWithAtMost: Enter positive amounts with at most two decimals.
stocktakingView.enterTheGoldPricePerGram: Enter the gold price per gram to check the total against nisab.
stocktakingView.theZakatableTotalReachesNisabSo: The zakatable total reaches nisab, so zakat is due if a full year has passed.
stocktakingView.theZakatableTotalIsBelowNisab: The zakatable total is below nisab, so no zakat is due on it.
stocktakingView.zakatIsDueWhenAFull: Zakat is due when a full lunar year passes from the day the total first reached nisab.
stocktakingView.mostScholarsValueTradeGoodsAt: Most scholars value trade goods at their market value on the zakat date; cost price is shown for reference.
stocktakingView.shopFixturesEquipmentAndPremisesAre: Shop fixtures, equipment and premises are not zakatable trade goods and are not included.
stocktakingView.thisIsAnEstimateToHelp: This is an estimate to help you prepare. Confirm the final amount with a trusted scholar.
stocktakingView.printThisSheetCountEachShelf: Print this sheet, count each shelf and write the counted quantity. Correct differences in MoonLightRetail’s Inventory screen.
stocktakingView.noSyncedStockForThisScope: No synced stock for this scope yet.

syncHealthCard.registerAShopsDeviceOnThe: Register a shop's device on the Devices page to start syncing.
syncHealthCard.reportsIncludeProjectedReturnsPendingBlo: Reports include projected returns; pending/blocked appear above. Cloud-complete ≠ empty Retail outbox.

tagCard.tagTotalsOverlapOneLineCan: Tag totals overlap (one line can carry several tags) and must not be summed to derive total business revenue.

updatesPage.conflictSameSequenceWithDifferentContent: Conflict: same sequence with different content.
updatesPage.releasePublicKeysAreNotConfigured: Release public keys are not configured.
updatesPage.notAllowedInTheCurrentRollout: Not allowed in the current rollout state.
updatesPage.percentageMustIncreaseAndBeAt: Percentage must increase and be at most 100.
updatesPage.releasesAreSignedOfflineCloudOnly: Releases are signed offline; Cloud only verifies and distributes. Store-scoped views follow the Store selector.
updatesPage.unverifiedPreviewTheServerVerifiesThe: Unverified preview — the server verifies the signature
updatesPage.confirmRevoke: Revoke release {version}? Devices that have not installed it will not receive it.
updatesPage.confirmMandatoryAll: Create a MANDATORY update rollout for ALL eligible devices in every Store? Devices install it automatically at their next safe point.
updatesPage.confirmStartMandatory: Start MANDATORY rollout of {version} to {count} device(s)?
updatesPage.confirmCancel: Cancel this rollout? Devices already installing will finish or roll back safely.

usersPage.passwordChangedOtherSessionsWereSigned: Password changed; other sessions were signed out.
usersPage.activationLink: One-time activation link for {login} (valid 24 h). Send it securely; it will not be shown again.
usersPage.confirmDisable: Disable {login}? All of their sessions end immediately.
usersPage.confirmRole: Change {login} to {role}? Their sessions end and they must sign in again.
usersPage.confirmMfaReset: Reset two-step verification for {login}? They must re-enroll at next sign-in.
usersPage.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate recovery codes? All previous recovery codes stop working immediately.
usersPage.confirmCreateOwner: Create {login} as OWNER? Owners can administer accounts and security.

authApi.tooManyAttemptsTryAgainLater: Too many attempts, try again later.
authApi.passwordMustBeAtLeast12: Password must be at least 12 characters.
authApi.activationLinkIsInvalidOrExpired: Activation link is invalid or expired.
authApi.sessionExpiredPleaseSignInAgain: Session expired, please sign in again.
authApi.atLeastOneActiveOwnerMust: At least one active owner must remain.
authApi.theOperationCouldNotBeCompleted: The operation could not be completed.

permissions.title: What Cloud may change
permissions.where: The shop sets these in MoonLightRetail: Settings → Cloud sync.
permissions.noDevice: No shop device can apply changes yet. Turn on Cloud sync in MoonLightRetail.
permissions.unknown: The shop’s permissions could not be loaded; MoonLightRetail still refuses anything it does not allow.

locked.online_selling: The shop does not allow Cloud to change online selling. It can be turned on in MoonLightRetail: Settings → Cloud sync.
locked.products: The shop does not allow Cloud to change product details or prices. It can be turned on in MoonLightRetail: Settings → Cloud sync.
locked.catalog: The shop does not allow Cloud to change the catalog structure. It can be turned on in MoonLightRetail: Settings → Cloud sync.

mfa.title: Confirm with your authenticator
mfa.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to send this change to the shop.
mfa.invalid: That code is not valid or was already used. Wait for the next code and try again.

errors.REVISION_CONFLICT: This item changed in Retail after the page loaded. Refresh before trying again.
errors.STORE_SCOPE_CONFLICT: This item belongs to another Store.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.CLOUD_PERMISSION_DISABLED: The shop does not allow Cloud to make this change. It can be turned on in MoonLightRetail: Settings → Cloud sync.
errors.CLOUD_PERMISSION_DENIED: Refused by the shop (not allowed in its Cloud settings)
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many wrong codes. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.commandFailed: The change could not be queued.
errors.invalidCode: Use 1–32 lower-case letters, digits or underscores for the code.
errors.priceFormat: Enter prices in pounds or dollars with at most two decimals, like 560.00.

catalogAdmin.name: Name
catalogAdmin.productLoadFailed: The product could not be loaded.
catalogAdmin.pendingProductNote: A change is pending. The values below are what Cloud has now, not the result yet.
catalogAdmin.typeCheckedByRetail: Retail checks the type fits the product.
catalogAdmin.retailValidates: Retail applies the same checks as its own screens.
catalogAdmin.frameOptionsReadOnly: Frame options are managed in MoonLightRetail and shown here read-only.
catalogAdmin.categoryOnlineHint: Turning the category off removes its products from online channels without changing each product’s own online setting.
catalogAdmin.categoryDisableConfirm: Turning this category off removes its products from online channels without changing each product’s own online setting. Continue?
catalogAdmin.parentsHint: Retail makes the final check against cycles and depth limits.

operationsPage.title: Operations
operationsPage.hint: Open and acknowledged incidents need operator attention. Acknowledge suppresses the unacknowledged state only — it never claims recovery.
operationsPage.subject: subject
operationsPage.needsReviewHint: Alert intent predates atomic writes; reconcile explicitly if review warrants it
operationsPage.stillActive: Condition still active — resolve is blocked until it clears.
